title: Complete Python for Data Science & Engineering
subtitle: From Core Fundamentals to Advanced Numerical Analysis
description: Comprehensive interactive Python course based on CampusX Data Science Mentorship Program. Built for CodeMentor-AI with real-time browser code execution, automated test evaluation, and Socratic AI guidance.

modules.title: Python Fundamentals & Data Structures
modules.summary: Core syntax, variables, operators, conditionals, loops, strings, lists, tuples, sets, dictionaries, and functions.

modules.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
modules.summary: Classes, objects, constructors, encapsulation, static keyword, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, and memory internals.

modules.title: Advanced Python Programming
modules.summary: File handling, serialization (pickle & json), exception handling, custom exceptions, decorators, namespaces, and the LEGB rule.

modules.title: NumPy (Numerical Computing)
modules.summary: Vectorized arrays, multi-dimensional array manipulation, fancy indexing, broadcasting rules, and numerical computing tricks.

modules.title: Pandas (Data Analysis & Manipulation)
modules.summary: Series, DataFrames, data cleaning, GroupBy aggregations, merging/joining, MultiIndex analysis, vectorized string operations, and DateTime.

modules.title: Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Plotly & Seaborn)
modules.summary: 2D and 3D Matplotlib plots, subplots, interactive visualizations with Plotly Express, and advanced statistical plotting with Seaborn.
